name: kilobyte-image-optimizer
description: WordPress native React admin UI and browser image compression for Kilobyte Image Optimizer.

scripts.build:docs: rm -rf docs/dist docs/codecs .cache/docs-ssg/manifest.json && wp-scripts build --config webpack.docs.config.js && node -e "require('./.cache/docs-ssg/prerender.cjs').buildStaticSite(process.cwd())"
scripts.test:docs: node --test tests/js/core-and-seo.test.mjs && node tests/js/browser-e2e.mjs && node tests/js/audit-regressions.mjs
